## Selected Research Experience

- **Predictive Phenomics (2026):** Poster, *Agentic Recovery for Orchestration of Programmable Cloud Laboratories*, Washington, DC. [Agenda](https://pnnl.cventevents.com/event/b1510a8f-c5a0-4ae7-bd74-23a2cc86873a/agenda).
